answer: The Aerobex StepTracker 5K has a battery capacity of 200 mAh.
The device delivers up to 30 days of use on a single charge.
The device weighs 0.08 kg, which is 80 g (0.08 kg × 1000 g/kg = 80 g).
It is compatible with iOS and Android devices via Bluetooth 5.0.
The tracker is available in Crimson Red.
